optional_typography.observation: Local title rendering preserves plain-text S_3 / S_8 underscores (and the second title’s ν=(3,2)) literally. The body consistently uses math delimiters. This is a minor title typography choice; no KaTeX or body-rendering defect was confirmed.

diagram_candidates.rationale: The definition introduces runner-indexed bead rows, top-packing to form the e-core, and the runner partitions forming the e-quotient. A concrete abacus sketch could make these related constructions easier to visualize, while the formulas and prose already define them completely.
diagram_candidates.draw_or_check: For a small fixed e and normalized beta-set X, place bead ae+i at row a on runner i; show each runner’s beads sliding to its topmost occupied positions to obtain X^(e), then label the resulting core and the runner partitions λ^(i). Keep the residue/runner numbering and row convention aligned with def-beta-set-and-e-runner-abacus-of-a-partition.
diagram_candidates.status: Optional; current definition is complete and does not depend on a diagram.
